scenes.title: KFUPM Building-Materials Grip Test Bay
scenes.institution: Building Materials Laboratory — Mechanical Test Frame
scenes.reference_notes: Official laboratory page and its installed apparatus photograph reviewed. Two polished cylindrical columns support a heavy black top crosshead. Opposed large steel grip blocks fill the center opening, with prominent round adjustment hardware. The test frame sits in a working bay with wall-mounted records and side electronics. Single close photograph, partly occluded by an operator. Room plan, full frame dimensions and true grip actuation are not available. Original benign mechanical motion and inert coupon only; no material failure law or certified load rating.
